subject: Root cause of recurring pending-heartbeat notices: BEHIND alone raises a hand
body:
Six of these notices in two days were stale: 01d37110 and 607e886a today, plus the ones cleared in #2151 and #2170. Each time, the heartbeat itself landed minutes later.

Cause: scripts/mac/lane-tick.sh, _hb_pending_hand sets reason = "behind canonical" whenever merge_state is BEHIND, at any age. BEHIND is the normal state of a lane PR under strict up-to-date: any other merge makes it behind. So every busy hour produces a cloud hand that is already obsolete by the time it lands.

Proposed one-line fix (your file, so yours to make): drop the BEHIND arm, so the reason becomes
  observed.check_state === "failed" ? "terminal failed check" : observed.age_seconds >= 3600 ? "pending at least one hour" : null;
A PR that stays behind for an hour is still caught by the one-hour rule. A real failed check still raises at once. Fail-closed is unchanged for anything actually stuck.

Cloud cleared both of today's notices: #2194 and #2195. No owner action needed.
